title: Overflow — Thailand Flood Tracker
watch_title: Areas likely to flood in the next 3 days
intro: Tap a shaded area for its flood-risk explanation, or a dot for one station's reading.
cap_basins: Each shaded patch is a drainage area: all the land whose rain ends up in the same stretch of river. It is large, and scored as one unit. Colour = chance of flooding.
cap_stations: A sensor in a river. Colour = how full the river is compared with its banks.
cap_flow: Dashes move downstream. Faster dashes = water rising faster.
foot: Not an official warning. Indicative only — follow DDPM, TMD and ThaiWater for official information. Data: ThaiWater (HII), Open-Meteo, HydroSHEDS, geoBoundaries · Basemap © OpenFreeMap © OpenStreetMap contributors.
area_desc: The outlined drainage area — all land whose rain flows to the same river stretch{river}. It covers {provs} and gets one score.
disclaimer: Rule-based indicator, not an official forecast.
w_sub: In the area you're looking at: flood risk is rising, or a flood peak is on its way from upstream. Highest first.
w_empty: Nothing is heading your way in this view.
d_rain_obs: Rain over the last 72 h: {mm} mm
d_disc: River discharge forecast {x}× the recent median
d_up: Upstream area near {prov} is at {lvl} risk; peak reaches here in ~{h} h
w_summary: In this view: {a} heading your way · {b} already High or worse, holding steady
w_summary0: In this view: nothing heading your way · {b} already High or worse, holding steady
w_zoom: Zoom in to your area to narrow this list.
w_up: Upstream area near {prov} is at {lvl} risk — peak reaches here in ~{h} h
cap_cross: Where a major road crosses a river. Shown only when something is wrong nearby, and only once you zoom in. Not a road-closure notice.
x_solid: Water measured over the bank nearby
x_measured: Measured: {st} reads {pct}% of its bank — {over} m over it — {km} km {dir}.
x_measured0: Measured: {st} reads {pct}% of its bank — {over} m over it — at this crossing.
x_modelled: Forecast: the drainage area is at {lvl} risk {day}.
x_howto: This shows water near the crossing, not whether the road is open or closed. Check official road notices (Department of Highways, Department of Rural Roads) before travelling.
cap_khl: Drawn only while a station on that khlong reads 90% of its bank or more, in the station colours. Positions can be approximate. No arrows: khlong flow is often controlled by gates and pumps.
